caseName: Northern Natural Gas Co. v. State Corp. Commission
caseNameFull: Northern Natural Gas Co. v. State Corporation Commission of Kansas
attorneys: Will Wilson, Attorney General of Texas, and Linward Shivers, Assistant Attorney General, on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from the Supreme Court of Kansas. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 370 U. S. 901.) The motion of the State of Texas for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, is denied.
